caption: 🫐 2-Ingredient Blueberry Chia Jam for Toddlers 💙 So simple, naturally sweet, and perfect to keep on hand for PB&Js, toast, oatmeal, yogurt, pancakes, and more! Ingredients: • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries • 1 tbsp chia seeds • Optional sweetener — I skip it when the berries are nice and sweet! How to make it: Add the blueberries to a small saucepan and cook over low-medium heat for 3–4 minutes, until they burst and become soft and juicy. Gently mash them to your preferred texture. Turn off the heat, stir in 1 tbsp chia seeds, and let the jam sit for a few minutes. The chia seeds will soften and gel as the mixture cools, giving you that perfect jammy texture. 🫐 Store some in an airtight container in the fridge for the week, then freeze the rest in single-serve portions. I love having little portions ready to thaw whenever we want a quick PB&J. 🙌 #ToddlerRecipes #ToddlerMeals #ToddlerFood #easyrecipe #jam
